name: Redis Cloud
tagline: Redis Ltd.'s own managed Redis on AWS, Azure and GCP, with Active-Active geo-replication and tiering.
description: Redis Cloud is the managed service run by Redis Ltd., the company behind Redis, built on Redis Software (Enterprise). It offers a free 30 MB database, shared Essentials plans from about $5 per month, and dedicated Pro deployments with Active-Active CRDT-based multi-region replication, auto-tiering of cold data to SSD (Redis Flex), private connectivity and up to 99.999% availability. It is the place where Redis's newest features (search, vectors, JSON, time series) land first, available in all three hyperscalers' regions and marketplaces.

pricing.notes: Free 30 MB database; Pro from $0.014/hour with a $200/month minimum.

scale.notes: Pro plans shard across nodes, tier to SSD with Redis Flex and replicate Active-Active across regions.

strengths: Newest Redis features first, operated by the Redis core team
Active-Active CRDT replication for multi-region writes
Redis Flex tiers cold data to SSD for lower cost
Runs on AWS, Azure and GCP with marketplace billing
weaknesses: Proprietary service; Active-Active semantics are Redis-specific
Costs rise quickly with large in-memory datasets
useCases: Global session stores and leaderboards with multi-region writes
Vector search and semantic caching for AI apps
notIdealFor: Teams standardising on Valkey for licensing reasons
Very cost-sensitive hobby workloads beyond the free tier
